links.outcome: Diagnostic performance of specialized ECG AI versus general LLM on same ECG dataset for MI classification
links.effect: ECG Buddy accuracy 96.98% vs ChatGPT 65.95%; AUC 98.8% vs 57.34%; sensitivity 96.65% vs 36.40%; DeLong's test P < .001.
links.quote: DeLong’s test confirmed that ECG Buddy significantly outperformed ChatGPT (all P < .001).

links.outcome: ChatGPT-4o performance on ECG image MI diagnosis with a general model, and plausibility of explanations
links.effect: ChatGPT accuracy 65.95%, sensitivity 36.40%, AUC 57.34%; explanations clinically plausible in 7.5% of 40 cases, 40% completely incorrect.
links.quote: In an error analysis of 40 cases, ChatGPT provided clinically plausible explanations in only 7.5% of cases, whereas 35% were partially correct, 40% were completely incorrect, and 17.5% received no meaningful explanation.

screen.reason: The study is an empirical benchmark comparing the diagnostic performance of a multimodal LLM (GPT-4o) versus a specialized ECG AI tool (ECG Buddy) on a retrospective dataset of ECG images.
